related_work_framing.close_neighbor_title: OCC-RAG: Optimal Cognitive Core for Faithful Question Answering
related_work_framing.overlap: Compact models for faithful context QA with source citations and safe abstention are a close final-system surface.
related_work_framing.distinction: This project must be evaluated over evolving/update-heldout KB states with explicit answer support, citation support/recall, abstention boundaries, coverage, and amortized cost. Citation syntax or compact context QA alone is not novel enough.

synthesis.headline: Compact faithful-context QA is a close baseline family, but current evidence says citation syntax and safe-looking abstention are not enough.
claim_boundary: Do not claim the project is the first compact faithful-context-QA model.
Do not claim citation syntax or source-citation formatting as grounded correctness.
Claim only the narrower update-heldout amortization question after Qwen 3B is judged.
true_baseline_needed: Run an OCC-RAG-like compact faithful-context-QA model on the same compact evidence packs and final dated/versioned KB windows.
Judge it with the same answer support, abstention support, citation recall, and coverage metrics.
Report cost per query and whether any per-query verifier/teacher is used.
Compare against the Qwen joint-action row after the trained Qwen smoke exists.

llm_budget.note: This comparison reads existing local artifacts and primary-source URLs from the novelty watchlist only.
